title: extra firm tofu press with double springs and curved
text: extra firm tofu press with double springs and curved. I purchased the "upgraded" version with springs on both the top and bottom.  It notes in the directions that you want to close slowly and they are not kidding.  The first one I pressed, I apparently closed too tightly at first and the tofu "cracked."  Honestly it wasn't a tragedy because I was just putting in a ramen (after I soaked in some spicy lo sodium soy) - but if you were going to fry it it wouldn't be nice and crisp looking edges with the cracked pieces.  So - mind the pressure - go slow - if you're really into perfectly pressed tofu.  It takes time to REALLY press - like 60 minutes or so and you'll want to twist just a little every 10 mins or so.  Easily went into the dishwasher for cleaning.  I will say that twisting it to clean it, or put the tofu in, or adjust for storage also takes a few minutes.  I decided to store slightly open. I've only used a couple of times- and not had any cracking or other disappointments with the press itself so far.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
